objective: Test consumer sensitivity of the frozen common-snapshot continuation result using a second Codex model without changing tasks, states, prompts, endpoints, or eligibility.

eligibility.rule: Inherited unchanged from protocol 26; inclusion uses historical-state feasibility only and no Terra outcome can alter inclusion.

design.consumer: Codex CLI gpt-5.6-terra, medium reasoning, ephemeral session

validity.valid_session: Agent session reaches evaluation and both future and prior verifiers have an observed result.
validity.infrastructure_or_setup_failure: Quarantine and rerun the identical key with the same model and protocol.

analysis.primary_endpoint: joint future success with prior-task preservation
analysis.primary_estimand: Within-future mean candidate success minus historical success, averaging s0/s1 and all three repeats, then averaging future pairs equally.
analysis.cross_consumer_interpretation: Compare sign, repository concentration, and uncertainty with the frozen Sol panel; do not pool models into an independence claim.
analysis.claim_scope: Within-OpenAI-family consumer sensitivity, not cross-vendor replication.
